Underdog

A pixel-art 1v1 duel. Lose a round and you pick a power from three cards.

Main street, gas station and a motel. Classic duel lanes.
No controller detected. Press any button on one to connect it.
  • Goal: win the round target before your opponent does.
  • Powers: lose a round and pick one of three power cards. Some cards combine into bonus combos.
  • Block: a short shield that stops bullets, then recharges. Use it to bait shots and pop out.
  • Bullet drop: every gun arcs differently. The sniper is nearly flat, the rifle drops a little, the SMG more, and the shotgun a lot. Aim a bit above far targets.
  • Kill cam: after every round the last few seconds replay from behind the shooter. Press any key to skip, or turn it off in Settings, Gameplay.
  • Cargo Ship: climb into a lifeboat and press the use key (G, or Select on a controller) to ride it between the main deck and the second floor. Ladders on the crane legs lead to the crane cab, and the stern tower has a bridge and captain's quarters you can walk into.
  • Sniper: hold right-click to scope (block stays on Q or Shift).
  • Sudden death: a round that drags past 75 seconds makes everyone bleed until someone drops.
  • Rebind: Settings → Controls lets you change every key, mouse button and controller button.
  • Coins: win rounds and matches to unlock hats, tracers and gun skins in the Locker.

Jump out to keep the speed, slide again on landing to build more Space on a wallWall jump, hold into a wall to wall slide GUse: ride a lifeboat lift on the Cargo Ship EscPause
Controller: left stick move, right stick aim, RT shoot, LT or RB block, B slide, A jump, X reload, Y ability, Start pause. Menus: D-pad or stick, A to select.
